project_type: React 19 SPA with TanStack Router/Start, Supabase backend, Cloudflare Workers deploy
build_system: Vite + Bun. Build commands: bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run build. No server-side functions - all logic is client-side with Supabase RLS or Supabase Edge Functions.
test_framework: No unit test framework configured. Playwright e2e exists but not relevant here. Validation via TypeScript compilation + Vite build.
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run bunx tsc --noEmit (must pass with 0 errors). 2. Run bun run build (must produce dist/ successfully).
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by TanStack Router plugin during build. Do NOT edit it manually.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. No Supabase CLI - migrations are SQL files stored in setup/ for manual execution. TypeScript types in src/integrations/supabase/types.ts must be manually updated to match schema changes. Client-side only - no createServerFn works on Cloudflare.
contribution_requirements: Never use .client.ts suffix in filenames. All DB operations via client-side Supabase with RLS. Migrations go in setup/ directory as SQL files.
key_patterns: 1. Pages are in src/routes/_authenticated/. 2. UI uses shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui/. 3. Auth via useAuth() hook from @/lib/auth returning isAdmin, hasRole, roles, user, profile. 4. Data fetching via @tanstack/react-query useQuery/useMutation. 5. Supabase client from @/integrations/supabase/client. 6. app_settings table used as key-value store (key text PK, value jsonb). Pattern: supabase.from('app_settings').select('value').eq('key', 'xxx').maybeSingle(). 7. Tabs component from @/components/ui/tabs (Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent). 8. Existing documentation page at src/routes/_authenticated/documentation.tsx has stats cards, period filter, task table with stage dropdown.
directory_structure: src/routes/_authenticated/ - all app pages. src/components/ui/ - shadcn primitives. src/lib/ - utilities (auth, crm, theme). src/integrations/supabase/ - client + types. setup/ - SQL migration files.
